user_instruction: chose in chat on 2026-10-24: implement scorer partial resume for final523; portable runtime binding; quarantine torn *.partial checkpoints automatically
declared_before: any final523 generation or scoring output exists
applies_to: stage final523 only; the selection300 and Pilot40 rule (--resume replays a complete cache and never fills holes) is unchanged
hole_definition: a checkpoint file that does not exist; a corrupt, hash-mismatched or key-mismatched checkpoint is a HOLD, not a hole
orphan_rule: any checkpoint file in the folder that does not belong to the current binding is a HOLD
failed_checkpoint_rule: a checkpoint that stored a scoring failure is reused as a failed row: the run reports it (reused_failed_rows) and cannot PASS; re-scoring such rows is not part of this policy and needs a separate user decision
torn_write_rule: a *.partial file is renamed to *.partial.quarantined-<run_id> and listed in the receipt; its row is scored fresh

canary.selection: reused delivered-summary rows whose stored result has no scoring failure, in run order: the first row of each profile, then of each stratum not yet covered, then evenly spaced positions, up to 6; deterministic and independent of scores
canary.views: view checkpoints are bound to the same key and are not re-scored; a view checkpoint is reused only together with a complete pass 1

unchanged: scorer v2 metrics, windows, IDF=false, FP32
PASS only when every row is scored and views are complete
failed generation cells stay in the denominator as NULL
no rows dropped, no scoring on a completed prefix
forbidden: resuming across different bundles or evidence ZIPs
changing assets, spec, code or pins between sessions
using partial resume for any other stage
choosing which rows to reuse by their scores
package_binding: only the packages pinned by the runtime amendment (runtime and support pins) enter the key; other installed packages do not
